title: Raksha Rajya Mantri Chaired the 15th Defence Information Technology Consultative Committee Meeting in New Delhi
text:
Press Release Page | Press Information Bureau

Ministry of Defence

Raksha Rajya Mantri Chaired the 15th Defence Information Technology Consultative Committee Meeting in New Delhi

प्रविष्टि तिथि:
23 JUN 2026 3:50PM by PIB Delhi

Raksha Rajya Mantri Shri Sanjay Seth chaired the 15th meeting of Defence Information Technology Consultative Committee (DITCC)  conducted by Headquarter Integrated Defence Staff (HQ IDS) on June 23, 2026  in New Delhi. The meeting laid emphasis on Aatma-Nirbharta in IT and adoption of cutting edge enablers in a time-bound manner.

During the meeting, important policy decisions were deliberated by Subject Matter Experts on the use of disruptive technologies in Defence Services in the changing paradigm of warfare. The members deliberated on a number of relevant issues ranging from indigenisation of advanced chip manufacturing, development of sovereign Operating System and Data Base and strategic siting of data centres for Defence needs. The Committee gave clearance to projects that would have far-reaching benefits, not only for the Defence Forces, but also for the national technological developmental processes, in line with the government’s vision of
'
Viksit-Bharat'.

The meeting was attended by officers of the HQ IDS, Army, Navy, Air Force, Defence Research and Development Organisation, Ministry of Electronics & Information Technology and distinguished members of academia and industry.

***
